entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.jetAt
entries.docstring: The coordinate-level `k`-jet point of a field `f` at the point `x`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetAt (k : ℕ) (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (x : Space d) :
    JetPoint d m k where

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.jetAt_base
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetAt_base (k : ℕ) (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (x : Space d) :
    (jetAt k f x).base = x

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.jetAt_value
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetAt_value (k : ℕ) (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (x : Space d) :
    (jetAt k f x).value = f x

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.jetAt_coord
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetAt_coord (k : ℕ) (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (x : Space d)
    (I : DerivativeIndex d k) (a : Fin m) :
    (jetAt k f x).coord I a = ∂^[I.1] (fun y => (f y) a) x

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.jetAt_coord_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma jetAt_coord_zero (k : ℕ) (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (x : Space d)
    (a : Fin m) :
    (jetAt k f x).coord 0 a = (f x) a

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.jetCoordinatesAt_eq
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetCoordinatesAt_eq (k : ℕ) (g : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (x : Space d)
    (I : DerivativeIndex d k) (a : Fin m) :
    jetCoordinatesAt k g x I a = ∂^[I.1] (fun y => (g y) a) x

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.jetCoordinatesAt_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma jetCoordinatesAt_zero (k : ℕ) (g : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))
    (x : Space d) (a : Fin m) :
    jetCoordinatesAt k g x 0 a = (g x) a

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.jetAt_eq_ofBaseCoordinates
entries.snippet:
lemma jetAt_eq_ofBaseCoordinates (k : ℕ) (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))
    (x : Space d) :
    jetAt k f x = JetPoint.ofBaseCoordinates x (jetCoordinatesAt k f x)

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.JetFiberData
entries.docstring:
Fiber-coordinate data for jet points of order `k`. This records only the coordinates `u^a_I`,
not the base point in `Space d`.
entries.snippet:
structure JetFiberData (d m k : ℕ) where
  coord : JetCoordinates d m k

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.JetFiberData.«instance@24e9455d»
entries.snippet: instance : CoeFun (JetFiberData d m k) (fun _ => DerivativeIndex d k → Fin m → ℝ) where

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.JetFiberData.ext
entries.snippet:
@[ext]
lemma ext (V W : JetFiberData d m k) (hcoord : ∀ I a, V.coord I a = W.coord I a) : V = W

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.JetFiberData.value
entries.docstring: The zero-th order component of a jet-fiber direction, corresponding to the field value.
entries.snippet: def value (V : JetFiberData d m k) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.JetFiberData.value_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma value_apply (V : JetFiberData d m k) (a : Fin m) :
    V.value a = V.coord 0 a

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.JetFiberData.«instance@14f5f97d»
entries.snippet: instance : Zero (JetFiberData d m k) where

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.JetFiberData.«instance@47407776»
entries.snippet: instance : Add (JetFiberData d m k) where

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.JetFiberData.«instance@cddd31c6»
entries.snippet: instance : SMul ℝ (JetFiberData d m k) where

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.JetFiberData.zero_coord
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma zero_coord (I : DerivativeIndex d k) (a : Fin m) :
    (0 : JetFiberData d m k).coord I a = 0

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.JetFiberData.add_coord
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma add_coord (V W : JetFiberData d m k) (I : DerivativeIndex d k) (a : Fin m) :
    (V + W).coord I a = V.coord I a + W.coord I a

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.JetFiberData.smul_coord
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma smul_coord (c : ℝ) (V : JetFiberData d m k) (I : DerivativeIndex d k) (a : Fin m) :
    (c • V).coord I a = c * V.coord I a

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.JetPoint.addFiber
entries.docstring: Translate a jet point by a fiber-direction increment.
entries.snippet: def addFiber (J : JetPoint d m k) (V : JetFiberData d m k) : JetPoint d m k where

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.JetPoint.lineMap
entries.docstring: The affine line in jet space through `J` in the fiber direction `V`.
entries.snippet: def lineMap (J : JetPoint d m k) (V : JetFiberData d m k) (s : ℝ) : JetPoint d m k

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.JetPoint.addFiber_base
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma addFiber_base (J : JetPoint d m k) (V : JetFiberData d m k) :
    (J.addFiber V).base = J.base

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.JetPoint.addFiber_value
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma addFiber_value (J : JetPoint d m k) (V : JetFiberData d m k) :
    (J.addFiber V).value = J.value + V.value

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.JetPoint.addFiber_coord
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma addFiber_coord (J : JetPoint d m k) (V : JetFiberData d m k)
    (I : DerivativeIndex d k) (a : Fin m) :
    (J.addFiber V).coord I a = J.coord I a + V.coord I a

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.JetPoint.lineMap_base
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma lineMap_base (J : JetPoint d m k) (V : JetFiberData d m k) (s : ℝ) :
    (J.lineMap V s).base = J.base

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.JetPoint.lineMap_coord
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma lineMap_coord (J : JetPoint d m k) (V : JetFiberData d m k) (s : ℝ)
    (I : DerivativeIndex d k) (a : Fin m) :
    (J.lineMap V s).coord I a = J.coord I a + s * V.coord I a

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.jetDirectionAt
entries.docstring: The jet-fiber direction determined by a field `g` at a point `x`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetDirectionAt (k : ℕ) (g : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))
    (x : Space d) :
    JetFiberData d m k where

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.jetDirectionAt_coord
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDirectionAt_coord (k : ℕ) (g : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (x : Space d)
    (I : DerivativeIndex d k) (a : Fin m) :
    (jetDirectionAt k g x).coord I a = ∂^[I.1] (fun y => (g y) a) x

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.jetDirectionAt_coord_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDirectionAt_coord_zero (k : ℕ) (g : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))
    (x : Space d) (a : Fin m) :
    (jetDirectionAt k g x).coord 0 a = (g x) a

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.jetCoordinatesAt_add_smul
entries.snippet:
lemma jetCoordinatesAt_add_smul (k : ℕ) (f g : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))
    (x : Space d) (s : ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) :
    jetCoordinatesAt k (fun y => f y + s • g y) x =
      jetCoordinatesAt k f x + s • jetCoordinatesAt k g x

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.jetAt_add_smul
entries.snippet:
lemma jetAt_add_smul (k : ℕ) (f g : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))
    (x : Space d) (s : ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) :
    jetAt k (fun y => f y + s • g y) x = (jetAt k f x).lineMap (jetDirectionAt k g x) s

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.jetCoordinatesAt_contDiff
entries.docstring: Smoothness of the jet-coordinate map of a smooth field.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetCoordinatesAt_contDiff (k : ℕ) (g : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (jetCoordinatesAt k g)

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.jetBaseCoordinates_contDiff
entries.docstring: Smoothness of the base-plus-coordinate jet map of a smooth field.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetBaseCoordinates_contDiff (k : ℕ) (g : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : Space d => (x, jetCoordinatesAt k g x))

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.notMem_tsupport_coord
ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.jetCoordinatesAt_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
entries.docstring: Outside the topological support of a field, all of its jet coordinates vanish.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetCoordinatesAt_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (k : ℕ)
    (g : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) {x : Space d}
    (hx : x ∉ tsupport g) :
    jetCoordinatesAt k g x = 0

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.jetDirectionAt_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
entries.docstring: Outside the topological support of a field, the corresponding jet-fiber direction vanishes.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDirectionAt_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (k : ℕ)
    (g : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) {x : Space d}
    (hx : x ∉ tsupport g) :
    jetDirectionAt k g x = 0

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.Lagrangian
entries.docstring: A local `k`-th order Lagrangian for fields `Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)`.
entries.snippet:
structure Lagrangian (d m k : ℕ) where
  toFun : JetPoint d m k → ℝ
  coordDeriv : DerivativeIndex d k → Fin m → JetPoint d m k → ℝ
  hasDerivAlongFiber :
    ∀ J : JetPoint d m k, ∀ V : JetFiberData d m k,
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => toFun (J.lineMap V s))
        (∑ I : DerivativeIndex d k, ∑ a : Fin m, coordDeriv I a J * V.coord I a) 0

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.Lagrangian.«instance@43bf9c65»
entries.snippet: instance : CoeFun (Lagrangian d m k) (fun _ => JetPoint d m k → ℝ) where

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.Lagrangian.fiberDerivative
entries.docstring: The derivative of `L` along the fiber-jet direction `V` based at `J`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fiberDerivative (L : Lagrangian d m k) (J : JetPoint d m k)
    (V : JetFiberData d m k) : ℝ

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.Lagrangian.hasDerivAt_lineMap
entries.snippet:
lemma hasDerivAt_lineMap (L : Lagrangian d m k) (J : JetPoint d m k) (V : JetFiberData d m k) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => L (J.lineMap V s)) (L.fiberDerivative J V) 0

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.Lagrangian.ContinuousInCoordinates
entries.docstring: Continuity of a local lagrangian in the explicit local jet coordinates `(x, u^a_I)`.
entries.snippet: def ContinuousInCoordinates (L : Lagrangian d m k) : Prop

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.Lagrangian.ContDiffCoordDerivInCoordinates
entries.docstring:
Intrinsic smoothness of the jet-coordinate derivatives of a local Lagrangian in the explicit
local jet coordinates `(x, u^a_I)`.
entries.snippet: def ContDiffCoordDerivInCoordinates (L : Lagrangian d m k) : Prop

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.Lagrangian.SmoothInCoordinates
entries.docstring:
Public regularity package for a smooth local lagrangian in explicit local jet coordinates:
continuity of the lagrangian itself together with smoothness of all jet-coordinate derivatives.
entries.snippet: def SmoothInCoordinates (L : Lagrangian d m k) : Prop

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.Lagrangian.ContDiffCoordDerivAlongField
entries.docstring: Smoothness of all coefficient functions `x ↦ ∂L/∂u_I^a (j^k f(x))` along a field `f`.
entries.snippet:
def ContDiffCoordDerivAlongField (L : Lagrangian d m k)
    (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) : Prop

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.Lagrangian.ContinuousCoordDerivAlongFamily
entries.docstring:
Continuity of the coefficient family `(s, x) ↦ ∂L/∂u_I^a (j^k(F s)(x))` along a
one-parameter family of fields `F : ℝ → Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)`.
entries.snippet:
def ContinuousCoordDerivAlongFamily (L : Lagrangian d m k)
    (F : ℝ → Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) : Prop

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.Lagrangian.continuousAlongField_of_inCoordinates
entries.snippet:
lemma continuousAlongField_of_inCoordinates (L : Lagrangian d m k)
    (hcont : ContinuousInCoordinates L) (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    Continuous (fun x : Space d => L (jetAt k f x))

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.Lagrangian.contDiffCoordDerivAlongField_of_inCoordinates
entries.snippet:
lemma contDiffCoordDerivAlongField_of_inCoordinates (L : Lagrangian d m k)
    (hcoord : ContDiffCoordDerivInCoordinates L) (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    ContDiffCoordDerivAlongField L f

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.Lagrangian.continuousCoordDerivAlongFamily_of_inCoordinates
entries.snippet:
lemma continuousCoordDerivAlongFamily_of_inCoordinates (L : Lagrangian d m k)
    (hcoord : ContDiffCoordDerivInCoordinates L)
    (F : ℝ → Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))
    (hjet : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × Space d => (p.2, jetCoordinatesAt k (F p.1) p.2))) :
    ContinuousCoordDerivAlongFamily L F

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.Lagrangian.alongField
entries.docstring: Evaluate a local Lagrangian along the `k`-jets of a field.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def alongField (L : Lagrangian d m k)
    (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) : Space d → ℝ

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.Lagrangian.alongField_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma alongField_apply (L : Lagrangian d m k)
    (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (x : Space d) :
    L.alongField f x = L (jetAt k f x)

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.evalOnJet
entries.docstring: Evaluate a local jet-dependent function along the `k`-jet of a field.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def evalOnJet (k : ℕ) (F : JetPoint d m k → ℝ)
    (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    Space d → ℝ

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.totalDerivative
entries.docstring: The total derivative of a jet-dependent function in the coordinate direction `i`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def totalDerivative (k : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (F : JetPoint d m k → ℝ)
    (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) : Space d → ℝ

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.iteratedTotalDerivative
entries.docstring: The iterated total derivative indexed by a multi-index.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def iteratedTotalDerivative (k : ℕ) (I : MultiIndex d) (F : JetPoint d m k → ℝ)
    (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) : Space d → ℝ

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.evalOnJet_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma evalOnJet_apply (k : ℕ) (F : JetPoint d m k → ℝ)
    (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (x : Space d) :
    evalOnJet k F f x = F (jetAt k f x)

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.totalDerivative_eq
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma totalDerivative_eq (k : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (F : JetPoint d m k → ℝ)
    (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    totalDerivative k i F f = ∂[i] (fun x => F (jetAt k f x))

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.iteratedTotalDerivative_eq
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedTotalDerivative_eq (k : ℕ) (I : MultiIndex d) (F : JetPoint d m k → ℝ)
    (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    iteratedTotalDerivative k I F f = ∂^[I] (fun x => F (jetAt k f x))

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.iteratedTotalDerivative_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedTotalDerivative_zero (k : ℕ) (F : JetPoint d m k → ℝ)
    (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    iteratedTotalDerivative k (0 : MultiIndex d) F f = evalOnJet k F f

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.iteratedTotalDerivative_single
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedTotalDerivative_single (k : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (F : JetPoint d m k → ℝ)
    (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    iteratedTotalDerivative k (Physlib.MultiIndex.increment 0 i) F f =
      totalDerivative k i F f

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.HasTotalDivergenceDensity
entries.docstring:
A lagrangian density has total-divergence form if, along every field, it is the sum of the
total derivatives of a jet-dependent current. A current of order `k` gives a density of order
`k + 1`.
entries.snippet:
def HasTotalDivergenceDensity (L : Lagrangian d m (k + 1))
    (current : Fin d → JetPoint d m k → ℝ) : Prop

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.IsEulerLagrangeTrivial
entries.docstring:
A local lagrangian is Euler-Lagrange-trivial if its Euler-Lagrange operator vanishes along
every field.
entries.snippet: def IsEulerLagrangeTrivial (L : Lagrangian d m k) : Prop

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.TotalDivergence
entries.docstring:
A packaged local total divergence.

The current has order `k`, while the associated lagrangian has order `k + 1`, matching the
coordinate expression `L = ∑ i, Dᵢ Bᵢ`. The Euler-Lagrange-triviality field records the
variationally trivial direction needed by later equivalence results.
entries.snippet:
structure TotalDivergence (d m k : ℕ) where
  lagrangian : Lagrangian d m (k + 1)
  current : Fin d → JetPoint d m k → ℝ
  hasTotalDivergenceDensity : HasTotalDivergenceDensity lagrangian current
  isEulerLagrangeTrivial : IsEulerLagrangeTrivial lagrangian

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.TotalDivergence.«instance@5c9b98ce»
entries.snippet: instance : CoeFun (TotalDivergence d m k) (fun _ => Lagrangian d m (k + 1)) where

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.TotalDivergence.actionDensity_eq
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma actionDensity_eq (T : TotalDivergence d m k)
    (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    actionDensity T.lagrangian f =
      fun x => ∑ i : Fin d, totalDerivative k i (T.current i) f x

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.TotalDivergence.eulerLagrangeOp_eq_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma eulerLagrangeOp_eq_zero (T : TotalDivergence d m k)
    (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    eulerLagrangeOp T.lagrangian f = 0

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.TotalDivergence.isCritical
entries.snippet:
lemma isCritical (T : TotalDivergence d m k)
    (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))
    (hTf : IsAdmissibleForAction T.lagrangian f)
    (hT : Lagrangian.SmoothInCoordinates T.lagrangian) :
    IsCritical T.lagrangian f

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.HasTotalDivergenceDifference
entries.docstring:
A lagrangian `target` differs from `source` by the density of a packaged total divergence.

The total divergence has current order `k`, hence its associated lagrangian and both compared
lagrangians have order `k + 1`.
entries.snippet:
def HasTotalDivergenceDifference (source target : Lagrangian d m (k + 1))
    (T : TotalDivergence d m k) : Prop

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.IsEulerLagrangeEquivalent
entries.docstring:
Two local lagrangians are Euler-Lagrange equivalent when they determine the same local

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.TotalDivergenceEquivalence
entries.docstring:
A packaged equivalence between two local lagrangians whose densities differ by a total
divergence.

The field `sameEulerLagrangeOp` records the variational consequence in the current Alpha API. It
will become a theorem once the stack has enough symbolic calculus for coordinate derivatives of
total divergences.
entries.snippet:
structure TotalDivergenceEquivalence (d m k : ℕ) where
  source : Lagrangian d m (k + 1)
  target : Lagrangian d m (k + 1)
  divergence : TotalDivergence d m k
  hasTotalDivergenceDifference :
    HasTotalDivergenceDifference source target divergence
  sameEulerLagrangeOp : IsEulerLagrangeEquivalent source target

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.TotalDivergenceEquivalence.actionDensity_eq
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma actionDensity_eq (E : TotalDivergenceEquivalence d m k)
    (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    actionDensity E.target f =
      fun x => actionDensity E.source f x + actionDensity E.divergence.lagrangian f x

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.TotalDivergenceEquivalence.eulerLagrangeOp_eq

lemma eulerLagrangeOp_eq (E : TotalDivergenceEquivalence d m k)

    eulerLagrangeOp E.target f = eulerLagrangeOp E.source f

entries.name: le_of_littleO
entries.snippet:
theorem le_of_littleO {V : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V]
    {f : V → ℝ} {x₀ x : V} {C : ℝ}
    (hx : C * (‖x - x₀‖ ^ 2) ≤ iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f x₀ fun _ ↦ x - x₀)
    (hx₀ : fderiv ℝ f x₀ x = fderiv ℝ f x₀ x₀)
    (h₁ : ‖f x - ∑ i ∈ range 3, 1 / ↑i ! * iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x₀ fun _ ↦ x - x₀‖
      ≤ C / 2 * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ 2) :
  f x₀ ≤ f x

    (h : (fun x => f x - ∑ i ∈ range 3, 1 / (i)! * iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x₀ fun _ => x - x₀)
      =o[nhds x₀] fun x => ‖x - x₀‖ ^ 2) (h₀ : gradient f x₀ = 0) (hcd : ContDiffAt ℝ ⊤ f x₀)
    (hf : (iteratedFDerivQuadraticMap f x₀).PosDef) : IsLocalMin f x₀

    {m r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r] [Fintype m]
    (K : r → Matrix m m R) :
    ∑ i, star K i * K i = (stinespringOp K)ᴴ * stinespringOp K

entries.name: stinespringForm_CPTNI
entries.docstring: A useful identity for completely positive, trace non-increasing maps.
entries.snippet:
lemma stinespringForm_CPTNI {R : Type*} [RCLike R]
    {m r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m]
    (K : r → Matrix m m R)
  (hK : ∑ i, (K i)ᴴ * K i ≤ 1) :
  (stinespringOp K)ᴴ * (stinespringOp K) ≤ 1

entries.name: stinespringForm_CPTP_isometry
entries.docstring:
The Stinespring operator of a completely positive, trace-preserving maps
is an isometry. (Note that `stinespringOp K` is not a square matrix in general.)
entries.snippet:
lemma stinespringForm_CPTP_isometry {R : Type*} [Ring R] [StarRing R]
    {m r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m]
  {K : r → Matrix m m R}
  (hK : ∑ i, (K i)ᴴ * K i = 1) :
  (stinespringOp K)ᴴ * (stinespringOp K) = 1

entries.name: stinespringOrtho
entries.docstring:
Proving the columns of `V = stinespringOp K` are independent is a step
on the way to constructing the unitary dilation.
entries.snippet:
lemma stinespringOrtho {R : Type*} [RCLike R]
    {m r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m]
    {K : r → Matrix m m R}
    (hK : ∑ i, (K i)ᴴ * K i = 1) :
  Orthonormal (𝕜 := R)
      fun j : m => WithLp.toLp 2 fun i : m × r => stinespringOp K i j

entries.name: basisCard
entries.docstring:
`m` will of course be finite and bounded by `n` here,
but no need to assume or prove that.
entries.snippet:
lemma basisCard {R : Type*} [RCLike R] {n m : Type*} [Fintype n] {s : Matrix n m R}
    (ho : Orthonormal R fun j ↦ WithLp.toLp 2 fun i ↦ s i j) :
    Fintype.card n =
    ho.toSubtypeRange.exists_orthonormalBasis_extension.choose.card

entries.name: stinespringCard
entries.docstring:
Calculating the cardinality of the orthonormal basis obtained by
extending the Stinespring orthonormal set, the columns of `stinespringOp K`.
entries.snippet:
lemma stinespringCard {R : Type*} [RCLike R]
    {m r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m]
    {K : r → Matrix m m R}
    (hK : ∑ i, (K i)ᴴ * K i = 1) :
    Fintype.card (m × r) = (stinespringOrtho
    hK).toSubtypeRange.exists_orthonormalBasis_extension.choose.card

entries.name: onbPart_inner
entries.snippet:
lemma onbPart_inner {R : Type*} [RCLike R] {m r : ℕ} {K : Fin r → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R}
    (hK : ∑ i, (K i)ᴴ * K i = 1) {z : Fin r}
    {y : Fin m × Fin r} (hy : ¬y.2 = z)
    {x : Fin m × Fin r} (hx : ¬x.2 = z)
    (h : y ≠ x) :
    inner R (WithLp.toLp 2 <| onbPart hK y hy)
            (WithLp.toLp 2 <| onbPart hK x hx) = 0

entries.name: Ud_orthonormal₁
entries.docstring: One version of orthonormality of `stinespringOp`.
entries.snippet:
theorem Ud_orthonormal₁ {R : Type*} [RCLike R] {m r : ℕ} {K : Fin r → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R}
    (hK : ∑ i, (K i)ᴴ * K i = 1) (z : Fin r) :
    Orthonormal R fun y ↦ if hy : y.2 = z then WithLp.toLp 2 fun i ↦ stinespringOp K i y.1
    else WithLp.toLp 2 fun i ↦ onbPart hK y hy i

      WithLp.toLp 2 fun i ↦ if hy : y.2 = z then stinespringOp K i y.1 else onbPart hK y hy i

entries.name: stinespringGeneralForm_works
entries.docstring:
Note we don't need any special properties of M,
and we don't need K to be CPTP.

Uses `Fin` types because of the use of
`Fin.sum_univ_succAbove` in the proof.
entries.snippet:
lemma stinespringGeneralForm_works {R : Type*} [RCLike R] {m r : ℕ}
    (K : Fin r → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R) (z : Fin r)
    (M : Matrix (Fin m × Fin r) (Fin m × Fin r) R) :
    stinespringGeneralForm K z M = krausApply K

entries.snippet: def solidCylinder : Space 2 × ℝ → Space 3

entries.name: Space.solidCylinder_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma solidCylinder_eq :
    solidCylinder = (slice 2).symm ∘ (fun x : Space 2 × ℝ => (x.2, x.1))

entries.name: Space.solidCylinder_injective
entries.snippet: lemma solidCylinder_injective : Function.Injective solidCylinder

entries.snippet:
@[fun_prop]
lemma solidCylinder_continuous : Continuous solidCylinder

entries.name: Space.solidCylinder_measurableEmbedding
entries.snippet: lemma solidCylinder_measurableEmbedding : MeasurableEmbedding solidCylinder

entries.name: Space.norm_solidCylinder
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma norm_solidCylinder (x : Space 2 × ℝ) :
    ‖solidCylinder x‖ = √(‖x.2‖ ^ 2 + ‖x.1‖ ^ 2)

entries.name: Space.solidCylinderMeasure
entries.docstring:
The measure on `Space 3` corresponding to integration over a solid cylinder, i.e. the
  pushforward of the product of the solid-sphere (closed unit disk) measure on `Space 2` with the
  line measure along the axis.
entries.snippet: def solidCylinderMeasure : Measure (Space 3)

entries.name: Space.solidCylinderMeasure_hasTemperateGrowth
entries.snippet:
instance solidCylinderMeasure_hasTemperateGrowth :
    solidCylinderMeasure.HasTemperateGrowth

entries.name: Space.solidCylinderMeasure_sFinite
entries.snippet: instance solidCylinderMeasure_sFinite : SFinite solidCylinderMeasure

entries.name: Space.solidCylinderDist
entries.docstring:
The distribution on `Space 3` corresponding to integration over a solid cylinder.
  One can roughly think of this distribution as taking a test function `f` to its integral against
  a mass, charge or current density spread over a solid cylinder.
entries.snippet: def solidCylinderDist : (Space 3) →d[ℝ] ℝ

entries.name: Space.solidCylinderDist_apply_eq_integral_solidCylinderMeasure
entries.snippet:
lemma solidCylinderDist_apply_eq_integral_solidCylinderMeasure (f : 𝓢(Space 3, ℝ)) :
    solidCylinderDist f = ∫ x, f x ∂solidCylinderMeasure

entries.name: Space.solidCylinderDist_apply_eq_integral_disk_volume
entries.snippet:
lemma solidCylinderDist_apply_eq_integral_disk_volume (f : 𝓢(Space 3, ℝ)) :
    solidCylinderDist f =
    ∫ x, f (solidCylinder x) ∂((solidSphereMeasure 2).prod (volume (α := ℝ)))

entries.name: Space.solidCylinderMeasure_univ_pos
entries.snippet: lemma solidCylinderMeasure_univ_pos : 0 < solidCylinderMeasure Set.univ

lemma norm_sphericalCylinder (x : Metric.sphere (0 : Space 2) 1 × ℝ) :

entries.name: Space.sphericalShell
entries.docstring: The inclusion into `Space d` of its unit sphere `S^{d-1}` (the subtype coercion `x ↦ x.1`).

The distribution associated with a spherical shell.
  One can roughly think of this distribution as the distribution which
  takes test functions `f (r)` to `∫ d³r f(r) ρ(r)` where `ρ(r)` is the
  mass, charge or current etc. distribution.

    ∫ x, f (sphericalShell d x) ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.toSphere volume)
